market_summary: Wall Street closed Q3 mixed on Wednesday: S&P 500 -0.3% to 7,652, Nasdaq +0.2% to 26,861, SOX flat; for September the S&P fell 0.5% and the Nasdaq rose 1.9%. The 10-year sat at 5.29%, a 19-year high, the 30-year at 5.64%, and CME odds of an October hike ended at 36% after the soft core PCE print. Micron beat and guided Q1 to $61.5B but traded flat after hours; S&P futures +0.4%. Asia midday Thursday: ASX 200 -1.5% to 8,645 as banks fell 2% and the Australian 10-year hit 5.40%, Nikkei +2.3% on chip names, Kospi flat, Tankan +24 vs +25 forecast, AUD 0.694; the RBA's Financial Stability Review said Australia is "unlikely to be immune" to a global funding squeeze and named US$1-1.5T of opaque AI debt. Brent $98 (December contract), WTI $90; Gulf exports are back to 23.3m b/d, a US diesel export ban is undecided and OPEC+ is expected to hold on Sunday. Next 48h AEST: ISM manufacturing and Waller Fri 00:00, Jefferson 03:30, Bowman 05:00, Cook 05:30; US payrolls Fri 22:30 (consensus 162k); Tesla Q3 deliveries Friday; BYD September sales due.

AMZN.reason: Closed +1.01% on quarter-end day, top Dow gainer while the index fell 0.86%; after-hours +0.42%. No new company news, Prime Big Deal Days Oct 6-7 is the next catalyst.

AXOS.reason: Flat at +0.32% in a session where financials lagged; thin after-hours bid of +1.95% on no news. Nothing new ahead of the Oct 29 results.

BABA.reason: Down 0.2% with no fresh company news; the stock is down about 27% in 2026 after repeated earnings misses. Nothing yet to move it off watch.

ENPH.reason: Up 3.64% on top of Monday's +2.78% with no company news; tech and energy led the tape. Two-day bounce in a stock that is still well below the Citi target of $37, not enough to move off watch.

FIGR.reason: Down 1.54% as the 30-year mortgage rate ticked up to 7.60% and the 10-year held near 5.30%; after-hours +0.35%. No company news, rate pressure is the whole story.

GOOGL.reason: Up 0.9% in the session and another 1.5% after hours on Gemini 4 Argon, which Google says tops GPT-6 Astra and Anthropic's models on the Vals index after months of delay. Model cadence back on track supports adding.

LDI.reason: Fell 2.51% on the day with mortgage rates still rising (30-year 7.60%, +2bp) and MND saying no relief without an Iran settlement, weaker data or a clear inflation downtrend. Thin-margin originator with no catalyst; keep trimming.

META.reason: Down 1.8% Wednesday as OpenAI's Dots agents went after Muse's market, but Muse passed 5M downloads in under a month and the stock still had its best month since 2022. Hold until Muse shows monetisation.

MRVL.reason: Up 0.4% with no new company news; the Oct 6 investor day is the next catalyst and the stock is up roughly 210% in 2026. Hold into the event.

MU.reason: Flat on the day and +0.4% after hours despite revenue 5% and EPS 5% above consensus and a Q1 guide 8% above the Street; capex is going up and Q1 gross margin dips to ~86.25% from 87.0%. The print confirms the cycle but the stock had already priced it, so hold.

NFLX.reason: Slipped 1.02% as the Deutsche Bank upgrade failed to hold; after-hours +0.52%. Nothing new since the upgrade, next read is Q3 earnings.

NVDA.reason: Up 0.5% Wednesday on the CoreWeave Vera Rubin NVL72 rollout, and Micron named Nvidia as the partner for the first custom HBM4E (NVHBM) on next-gen GPUs. Demand signals keep firming; nothing changes the hold.

RKT.reason: Down 1.54% with the 30-year at 7.60% and the 10-year yield near 5.30%; after-hours +0.35%. Rate-locked until yields turn, no change.

TSM.reason: Down 0.2% in a mixed tape; Reuters says the Texas expansion is still under evaluation on top of the US$265B Arizona plan. Micron's call that memory stays supply-constrained through 2028 reads across to foundry demand; add ahead of Q3 results on Oct 15.

STRIPE.reason: Busy day: agreed to buy SMB lender Parafin (terms undisclosed) and made OUSD, the new Coinbase/Mastercard/Shopify/Visa-backed stablecoin, available by default to businesses on Stripe. Product and distribution moves, no new round or tender, mark unchanged.

OPENAI.reason: Regulatory heat rose again: the FTC is issuing civil investigative demands over rogue-agent harms, Altman declined Hawley's Senate hearing, and Brockman pulled further super PAC money calling it a distraction. Offset by the GPT-Synopsys revenue-share deal and the Moonshot distillation disclosure; no new closed round, mark unchanged.

headlines: Micron beat: $54.2B revenue, 87% gross margin, Q1 guide $61.5B vs $57B consensus; shares flat after hours, HBM sold out through 2027.
US 10-year hit 5.29%, a 19-year high; S&P 500 -0.3% at quarter-end, ASX 200 -1.5% at midday with banks down 2%.
Robinhood fell 3.2% on sell-the-news after its Summit; Meta -1.8%, Alphabet +0.9% and up again after hours on Gemini 4 Argon.
Anthropic's Q2 revenue reportedly $11.6B, 14x year on year; the Australian Senate AI hearing was called off, no new date.
RBA Financial Stability Review flags $1-1.5T of opaque AI debt and circular chip financing; Tankan +24, a touch under forecast.
Tonight AEST: ISM manufacturing Fri 00:00 with four Fed speakers; US payrolls and Tesla deliveries Friday night.
